latest_release.name: Edition 2026.11.1: Interview Bank and Incident Scenarios
latest_release.body:
Practise for AI engineering interviews against the course itself. This edition adds an interview bank of 482 questions and 60 measured incident scenarios, a mock interview skill, and code blocks rendered at build time.

[Interviews](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/interviews) · [Scenarios](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/interviews/scenarios) · [Skills](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/skills.html) · [Start learning](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com)

![Browsing the interview bank](https://github.com/rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch/releases/download/v2026.11.1/interview-bank.gif)

## Interview bank

- **482 questions in 23 cards**, from math and classical ML to inference serving, agents, protocols, sandboxes and system design.
- Each question shows the prompt first and folds the answer, so you answer before you read. A short answer, a full answer, follow-ups from L1 to L4, and the wrong answers that interviewers hear.
- Every answer links to the lesson or manual section that teaches it. Every number in an answer comes from a file in the repository.
- **7 role paths** pick the cards for a role, such as inference engineer or applied AI engineer.

## Incident scenarios

- **60 scenarios** built from real runs on the L4 and the GB10 in the SGLang, vLLM and Miles manuals.
- Each one gives the situation and the evidence, step by step: logs, metrics and configs, byte for byte from the run. Then the walkthrough, the resolution, and the wrong turns people take.

## Mock interviews with an agent

The new `interview-prep` skill runs a mock interview in your coding agent.

- It asks one question or one scenario and waits for your answer. It never shows part of the answer first.
- It grades your answer against the bank, asks follow-ups one at a time, and sends each gap to the lesson that teaches it.
- It keeps a record of your sessions in `INTERVIEW-LEARNING.md`.

## Site

- Code blocks on practice pages, cheat sheets and manuals are rendered once at build time with Shiki. Terminal blocks copy only the commands, and output blocks have no Copy button.
- New Miles RL cheat sheet.

## Fixes

- Review fixes across the interview answers, checked against their lessons: optimizer and schedule edge cases, attention and tokenizer code, cache pricing, eval statistics, and protocol and sandbox details.
- The generated interview indexes are now built on main after each merge, so contributions to the bank no longer conflict with each other.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch/compare/v2026.10.5...v2026.11.1
